test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a12bd11fbfc30a8d0916a595feb2e60694992d12bcee6a23fc3730ec760e73ef.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/757731852b1c67ff1cf92d83291d4076d2706ed4ff20c19384ffee2a29bf5209.png] 

⇒ 18 ÷ 3 = 2 + 3 + 1

⇒ 6 = 6 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c069bd6c9c7e6cefa711c7151d2fcfc04bc1122798d2f7e16618ee80465a879.png] 

⇒ 42 ÷ 3 = 3 + 4 + 7

⇒ 14 = 14 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c648162612df846e4144d594dd42e0c9b564e08469b65e9ee74a2f0ea63c03e5.png] 

⇒ ? ÷ 2 = 11 + 3 + 6

⇒ ? = 20 × 2

⇒ ? = 40

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
